name: Zimbra Detection Suite
summary: FIM, web, authentication, SOAP, MTA and host-noise rules for Zimbra mail servers, with the decoders they need.
summary_zh: 針對 Zimbra 郵件伺服器的檔案完整性、Web、認證、SOAP、MTA 與主機雜訊規則，並附上所需的解碼器。
author: Jason Tools
notes: zimbra-webfiles is the stock-file baseline. The shipped copy was generated from Zimbra 10.1.20 (FOSS and NETWORK editions combined) and is a starting point, not a substitute for generating your own.

Regenerate the baseline after every Zimbra install AND after every upgrade - an upgrade replaces version-stamped jars, and each new filename is unknown to the old baseline. Generate with: { find /opt/zimbra/jetty_base/webapps -type f \( -name '*.jsp' -o -name '*.jspx' -o -name '*.jar' -o -name '*.class' -o -name '*.war' -o -name '*.html' \); find /opt/zimbra/lib/ext -type f; } | sort -u | sed 's/$/:legit/'   -- note that lib/ext takes ALL file types, not just jars: rule 100806 alerts on any file there, and .wsdl, .xsd and .properties files live in it.

Private addresses (10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16, 127/8, 100.64/10, fc00::/7, fe80::/10) are written into the rules, so the pack is quiet and useful on a fresh install with every list left as shipped. etc/lists/zimbra-internal-networks is optional tuning: an address listed there is never treated as external, for an office NAT address or a proxy with a public address. ::1 is deliberately not in the rules: a negated ::1 in 4.14.7 also excludes every IPv4 address.
The agent's syscheck must monitor the Zimbra directories with whodata=yes for the writing process to be recorded.

The stock baseline does not include WEB-INF/lib/*.jar or lib/ext. Those paths are the usual source of false positives on rules 100803 and 100806; regenerating the baseline fixes it at the source, which is better than suppressing the alerts.

Hash matching on file integrity events is provided by the jt-malware-hash pack, rule 100141, against a list rebuilt nightly. This pack no longer ships a hash list of its own: the one it had contained a single placeholder, so the level 15 rule reading it had never fired.

Rule 100807 was one rule covering every extension from jsp to elf, and it did not look at the file mode. Measured over fifteen days on a development host it produced 6,133 alerts at level 12, of which 5,538 were .py files, most of them source code with no execute bit that could never have been run. It is now split by whether the extension needs that bit: 100807 keeps the web application artefacts, which a container loads regardless of mode, and 100809 takes the scripts and binaries and requires the execute bit. Verified: a .py at 0755 matches 100809, the same file at 0644 is silent. Rule 100810 then excludes build and test toolchain scratch directories, which produced 399 of these alerts in a single day on a build host.

Rule 100808 (a stock file's contents rewritten, level 13) could never fire before 2.7: its sibling 100800 claimed the event first and 100801 settled every stock-file change at level 0. 100801 now takes only changes that leave the contents alone, and 100808 takes the rest, in the web directories and lib/ext alike. Expect a batch of these on every Zimbra upgrade, which rewrites stock files; regenerate the baseline afterwards.

100940 and 100941 (a cron entry or systemd unit changed, level 13) no longer alert on a deletion: removing a scheduled task is not persistence. About half of their level 13s were deletions. The built-in rule 553 still records them at level 7.

3.0 ships the decoders. Before 3.0 the rules named three decoders the pack did not contain, so on a manager without a hand-made copy wazuh-analysisd refused the whole ruleset. The decoder files keep the names such copies had (0001-zimbra_decoders.xml, 0002-zimbra_mailbox_decoders.xml); installing over one replaces it and the installer keeps the original as a backup.

Measured on two Zimbra 10.1 servers over 41 days: about 105,000 alerts a day. 84,000 were Zimbra's own sudo and su housekeeping (zmmailboxdmgr status every few seconds, each with two PAM session lines), 17,000 one postdrop process stuck on a permission error, 1,300 two internal hosts refused for want of reverse DNS, 700 a monitoring check refused by sudo, 200 configuration files rewritten by zmconfigd, and the only mailed pack alerts (2.7 a day) were phones syncing through Z-Push. 3.0 handles each as a child of the rule that raised it and keeps one alert per real condition: replayed on the same alerts, about 1,700 a day remain, most of them from outside this pack (a refused SNMP sudo, netstat port changes, SCA results).

Rules that could never fire are fixed: the login-success, admin-login, cracked-password and multi-source rules (100845-100852; <action> compares as a plain string unless a type is given), the burst-of-mail rule (100925/100928) and the two-factor rule (100851), which looked in audit.log for lines it never contains, and the repeat rules 100825, 100826 and 100923, which counted only events that ended at their parent. 100849 and 100922 could report an internal admin login or export at level 14 and now require an external address; 100846 hung off every login rule in the ruleset (an SSH brute force was reported as Zimbra) and is now Zimbra-only.

Requests through a proxy (Z-Push, a reverse proxy) are attributed to the client the proxy reported, the first oip address, instead of decoding with no address and no account. The address is only as trustworthy as the proxy chain: where a proxy appends to a client-supplied X-Forwarded-For header instead of replacing it, the client can choose it.

With zimbraLogToSyslog set, mailbox and audit lines also arrive through syslog (programs zimbra_mailbox and zimbra_audit). Only the copies read from /opt/zimbra/log count; rules 100834 and 100839 drop the others. Counting both halved every threshold: a third of the old SOAP alerts came from the syslog copy, and the generic rule 2501 raised every copied login failure a second time.

New in 3.0: infected mail or spam sent by a local account (level 12), virus scanning failing (level 10), Postfix unable to deliver to the mailbox server, remote servers refusing this server's mail as spam, queue growth, service and disk status from zimbramon, opendkim key errors, admin-console changes and logins, an administrator taking over another account's session, account lockout, application passwords and mail-filter changes.

Left to others on purpose: SMTP AUTH password failures per address are the built-in Postfix rules 3332 and 3357 (Zimbra also logs them in audit.log, where 100841-100844 count them per account); LDAP (slapd) belongs to the jt-ucs pack; Z-Push devices to the jt-zpush pack; known-bad addresses to jt-ioc (100991, which read jt-ioc's list, is removed: without jt-ioc it was ignored with a warning, with it 906001 already covers it).

etc/lists/zimbra-service-accounts is optional tuning and ships with a placeholder that matches nothing. Nothing needs to be listed: an internal tool that reads a mailbox through a delegated administrator session is reported once (100897) instead of raising the bulk-reading rules. List an account only to quiet an archiver or probe that reads a lot with its own credentials.

Several 3.0 rules raise a condition that repeats every second until fixed once every six hours (attribute ignore). The window is per rule, not per host, and starts over when the manager restarts or reloads the ruleset. wazuh-logtest does not apply it; it was verified through analysisd itself.

Rules 100860-100865 need an auditd rule file with the zimbra_* keys and rules 100880-100902 and 100992 need state-audit scripts writing /var/log/zimbra-state-audit.json. Neither ships with this pack; without them those rules stay silent.

3.1 applies one policy to every successful login, with no site data: an ordinary account from a private address is level 2 (recorded, no alert), and level 3 only the first time that (account, address) pair is seen; from a public address level 2, and level 5 the first time for the pair; an administrator-class login (the admin SOAP endpoint, cmd=AdminAuth, or the built-in names admin@, administrator@, root@) is level 3 from a private address and 8 from a public one; a success after repeated failures is 14 from the same address and 11 for the same account. Public addresses are level 5 only for a new pair because Z-Push logs in on every request it relays: measured 435 such logins a day, 2.4 new pairs a day.

First-seen pairs are remembered by the manager (fts) per agent, so a fresh install reports each existing (account, address) pair once in its first days: on the two measured servers about 40 alerts at level 3 or 5 in the first week, then about one a day. A phone or a monitoring probe produces one alert per address, ever.

Mailbox reading through a delegated administrator session from a private address is not counted by the bulk-reading rules 100972/100973 any more: it is reported the first time for each (administrator, mailbox, address) triple at level 5 (100897), and an administrator starting on five different mailboxes within an hour raises level 12 (100899). Measured: one internal tool read 1,788 messages of one mailbox in 8.8 days; 3.0 raised 1.3 level 12-14 alerts a day for it unless its account was listed, 3.1 raises one level 5 alert, ever. From a public address such reads are still counted.

100852 (one account from several public addresses, level 13) now counts first-seen public pairs. In 3.0 it used different_srcip, which in 4.14.7 counts earlier events whose address differs from the current one, not distinct addresses: two logins from one address and one from a second already counted as three sources, so a phone changing its mobile address within an hour would have raised it.

preauth logins (an SSO integration logs in every user this way) are recorded at level 2 instead of level 13 each; that preauth is in use is raised at most once a day at level 10 (100831), and preauth into an administrator account at level 12 every time (100832).
notes_zh: zimbra-webfiles 是原廠檔案基線。隨附的版本產生自 Zimbra 10.1.20（FOSS 與 NETWORK 版聯集），是起點而非自行產生的替代品。

每次 Zimbra 安裝後**與每次升級後**都要重建基線 —— 升級會替換帶版本號的 jar，新檔名對舊基線來說是未知的。產生方式：{ find /opt/zimbra/jetty_base/webapps -type f \( -name '*.jsp' -o -name '*.jspx' -o -name '*.jar' -o -name '*.class' -o -name '*.war' -o -name '*.html' \); find /opt/zimbra/lib/ext -type f; } | sort -u | sed 's/$/:legit/''   注意 lib/ext 要收「所有」檔案型別而非只有 jar：規則 100806 對該目錄下任何檔案都告警，而 .wsdl / .xsd / .properties 都在裡面。

私有位址（10/8、172.16/12、192.168/16、127/8、100.64/10、fc00::/7、fe80::/10）已寫進規則，所以全新安裝、所有清單維持原樣時，套件就能保持安靜而且有用。etc/lists/zimbra-internal-networks 是選用的調校：列在裡面的位址永遠不會被當成外部來源，適用於辦公室 NAT 位址或擁有公開位址的代理。規則刻意不含 ::1：在 4.14.7 中，否定的 ::1 也會排除所有 IPv4 位址。
agent 端 syscheck 需以 whodata=yes 監控 Zimbra 目錄才能取得寫入程序資訊。
原廠基線未含 WEB-INF/lib/*.jar 與 lib/ext，這是 100803 / 100806 誤報的主要來源；重建基線可從源頭解決，優於用抑制規則掩蓋。
檔案完整性事件的雜湊比對由 jt-malware-hash 套件的規則 100141 提供，比對的是每晚重建的清單。本套件不再自帶雜湊清單：原本那份只有一個佔位符，讀取它的 level 15 規則從未觸發過。

規則 100807 原本是一條涵蓋 jsp 到 elf 全部副檔名、而且不看檔案權限的規則。在一台開發主機上實測 15 天產生 6,133 筆 level 12，其中 5,538 筆是 .py，多數是沒有執行權限位元的原始碼，根本不可能被執行。現在依「這個副檔名要不要 x 位元」拆開：100807 留下由容器載入、不看權限的網頁應用產物，100809 收下腳本與二進位檔並要求執行權限位元。實測：0755 的 .py 命中 100809，同一個檔案 0644 時靜默。規則 100810 再排除建置與測試工具鏈的暫存目錄 —— 在一台建置主機上，那類目錄一天就貢獻了其中 399 筆。
規則 100808（原廠檔案內容被改寫，level 13）在 2.7 之前不可能觸發：同層的 100800 先接走事件，其子規則 100801 又把所有原廠檔案變更定為 level 0。現在 100801 只收內容沒變的變動，其餘交給 100808，網站目錄與 lib/ext 都適用。Zimbra 每次升級都會改寫原廠檔案，會出現一批這條告警；升級後請重新產生基準清單。
100940／100941（排程或 systemd 單元被修改，level 13）不再對刪除告警：刪掉排程不是持久化。原本約一半的 level 13 是刪除事件。刪除仍由內建 553 以 level 7 記錄。
3.0 起隨附解碼器。3.0 之前規則引用了三個套件裡沒有的解碼器，在沒有手動副本的管理端上 wazuh-analysisd 會拒絕載入整個規則集。解碼器檔名沿用這類副本的名稱（0001-zimbra_decoders.xml、0002-zimbra_mailbox_decoders.xml），安裝時會取代它，安裝程式會保留原檔備份。

在兩台 Zimbra 10.1 伺服器上實測 41 天：每天約 105,000 筆告警。其中 84,000 筆是 Zimbra 自己透過 sudo 與 su 做的例行工作（每隔幾秒一次 zmmailboxdmgr status，每次再加兩行 PAM 工作階段），17,000 筆是一個卡在權限錯誤的 postdrop 程序，1,300 筆是兩台缺少反解的內部主機被拒收，700 筆是被 sudo 拒絕的監控檢查，200 筆是 zmconfigd 改寫設定檔，而本套件唯一會寄信的告警（每天 2.7 筆）全是手機經 Z-Push 同步。3.0 對每一項都以「引發它的那條規則的子規則」處理，每個真實狀況保留一則告警：用同一批告警重放，每天剩約 1,700 筆，多數來自本套件以外（被拒的 SNMP sudo、netstat 連接埠變化、SCA 結果）。

修正了不可能觸發的規則：登入成功、管理員登入、密碼被破解與多來源登入（100845-100852；<action> 未指定 type 時是逐字比對），以及到 audit.log 找它根本不會寫的內容的大量寄信（100925/100928）與兩步驟驗證（100851），還有只計入「最後停在父規則」事件的重複類規則 100825、100826、100923。100849 與 100922 可能把內部的管理員登入或匯出報成 level 14，現在要求外部來源；100846 原本掛在整個規則集的所有登入規則下（SSH 暴力破解會被報成 Zimbra），現在只看 Zimbra。
經代理（Z-Push、反向代理）進來的請求，現在記在代理回報的用戶端，也就是 oip 的第一個位址；原本這類記錄解不出位址也解不出帳號。這個位址的可信度取決於代理鏈：代理若是附加在用戶端自帶的 X-Forwarded-For 之後而不是取代它，用戶端就能自己指定這個位址。

設定 zimbraLogToSyslog 時，mailbox 與 audit 的記錄也會經 syslog 進來（程式名 zimbra_mailbox、zimbra_audit）。只有從 /opt/zimbra/log 讀到的那份會被計數，規則 100834 與 100839 會丟掉另一份。兩份都算會讓每個門檻減半：舊的 SOAP 告警有三分之一來自 syslog 副本，通用規則 2501 也會把每筆複製來的登入失敗再報一次。
3.0 新增：本地帳號寄出中毒信或垃圾信（level 12）、病毒掃描失效（level 10）、Postfix 無法投遞到信箱伺服器、遠端伺服器以垃圾信為由拒收本機的信、佇列暴增、zimbramon 的服務與磁碟狀態、opendkim 金鑰錯誤、管理主控台的變更與登入、管理員接管其他帳號的工作階段、帳號鎖定、應用程式密碼與郵件篩選規則變更。

刻意交給其他規則：依來源位址的 SMTP AUTH 密碼失敗是內建 Postfix 規則 3332 與 3357（Zimbra 也會記在 audit.log，100841-100844 依帳號計數）；LDAP（slapd）屬於 jt-ucs 套件；Z-Push 裝置屬於 jt-zpush 套件；已知惡意位址屬於 jt-ioc（引用 jt-ioc 清單的 100991 已移除：沒裝 jt-ioc 時它只會被警告後忽略，裝了的話 906001 已經涵蓋）。
etc/lists/zimbra-service-accounts 是選用的調校，隨附的是不會比對到任何帳號的佔位符。不需要列入任何帳號：透過管理員委派工作階段讀取信箱的內部工具只會回報一次（100897），不會觸發大量讀信規則。只有在封存工具或探針以自己的帳號大量讀信時，才需要把它列入。
3.0 有幾條規則對「修好之前每秒重複」的狀況每六小時只告警一次（ignore 屬性）。這個時間窗以規則為單位而非主機，管理端重啟或重新載入規則集後重新起算。wazuh-logtest 不會套用它，這部分是直接用 analysisd 驗證的。
規則 100860-100865 需要帶 zimbra_* 鍵值的 auditd 規則檔，100880-100902 與 100992 需要寫入 /var/log/zimbra-state-audit.json 的狀態稽核腳本。這兩者都不在本套件內；沒有它們，這些規則不會有任何告警。

3.1 對所有成功登入套用同一套原則，不需要任何站台資料：一般帳號從私有位址登入是 level 2（記錄、不告警），只有第一次出現這組（帳號、位址）時是 level 3；從公開位址是 level 2，該組第一次出現時 level 5；管理員等級的登入（管理 SOAP 端點、cmd=AdminAuth，或內建名稱 admin@、administrator@、root@）從私有位址是 level 3，公開位址是 8；連續失敗後的成功，同一位址是 14，同一帳號是 11。公開位址只在新組合時才是 level 5，因為 Z-Push 每轉送一個請求就登入一次：實測每天 435 筆這種登入，新組合每天 2.4 組。
第一次出現的組合由管理端記住（fts），以 agent 為單位，所以全新安裝後的頭幾天，每一組既有的（帳號、位址）都會回報一次：在兩台實測伺服器上，第一週約 40 則 level 3 或 5，之後每天約一則。手機或監控探針每個位址只會有一則告警，永遠如此。

從私有位址透過管理員委派工作階段讀取信箱，不再計入大量讀信規則 100972/100973：每一組（管理員、信箱、位址）第一次出現時以 level 5 回報（100897），管理員在一小時內開始讀取五個不同的信箱則是 level 12（100899）。實測：一個內部工具在 8.8 天內讀了同一個信箱 1,788 封信；3.0 若不把它的帳號列入，每天會產生 1.3 則 level 12-14 告警，3.1 只會產生一則 level 5，永遠如此。從公開位址的這類讀取仍會計數。
100852（同一帳號從多個公開位址登入，level 13）現在計算的是第一次出現的公開組合。3.0 用的是 different_srcip，它在 4.14.7 中計算的是「位址與目前事件不同」的先前事件數，而不是不同位址的數量：從一個位址登入兩次、另一個位址一次，就已經算成三個來源，手機一小時內換一次行動網路位址就會觸發。
preauth 登入（SSO 整合會用這種方式登入每一位使用者）改為每筆 level 2 記錄，不再是每筆 level 13；「伺服器正在使用 preauth」這件事每天最多以 level 10 回報一次（100831），以 preauth 登入管理員帳號則每次都是 level 12（100832）。

agent_group.name: zimbra
agent_group.description: Log collection the pack needs on the monitored host

setup.title: Install the pack and reload the ruleset on every node
setup.title_zh: 安裝套件並在所有節點重新載入規則集
setup.body: Install from this page, then use Reload Ruleset on the Rules tab. A cluster synchronises rule files but does not reload the workers.
setup.body_zh: 在本頁安裝後，到「規則」分頁按「重新載入規則集」。叢集只同步規則檔、不會重載 worker。

setup.title: Assign the Zimbra servers to the zimbra group
setup.title_zh: 把 Zimbra 伺服器加入 zimbra 群組
setup.body: The group collects the Zimbra logs (including /var/log/zimbra.log, where Postfix, amavis and zimbramon write), raises the agent's event queue so a Zimbra restart does not overflow it, and monitors the web root, extensions, configuration, cron, systemd and temporary directories. An existing group is never overwritten by the installer; compare it with the pack's copy. File-integrity and buffer settings apply after the agent restarts.
setup.body_zh: 群組會收集 Zimbra 記錄（包括 Postfix、amavis、zimbramon 寫入的 /var/log/zimbra.log），調大 agent 的事件佇列避免 Zimbra 重啟時溢出，並監控網站根目錄、擴充模組、設定、cron、systemd 與暫存目錄。已存在的群組不會被安裝程式覆蓋，請與套件版本比對。檔案完整性與緩衝設定要 agent 重啟後才生效。
setup.verify: After the agent restarts, grep -i 'duplicated\|buffer' /var/ossec/logs/ossec.log on the Zimbra server: a '(1958) ... duplicated' line only means the agent already read that file.
setup.verify_zh: agent 重啟後，在 Zimbra 伺服器上 grep -i 'duplicated\|buffer' /var/ossec/logs/ossec.log：出現「(1958) ... duplicated」只表示 agent 本來就有讀那個檔。

setup.title: auditd on the Zimbra servers (who wrote the file)
setup.title_zh: Zimbra 伺服器上的 auditd（記錄是誰寫入檔案）
setup.body: The group monitors the web root with whodata, which records the process and user that wrote a file. On Linux whodata needs auditd running; without it the agent falls back to ordinary real-time monitoring, and a web shell is reported with no writer. Install auditd before assigning the host, then restart the agent.
setup.body_zh: 群組以 whodata 監控網站根目錄，記錄寫入檔案的處理程序與使用者。Linux 上 whodata 需要 auditd；沒有時 agent 會退回一般即時監控，web shell 落地時看不到寫入者。請先安裝 auditd 再把主機加入群組，然後重啟 agent。
setup.code:
apt install auditd        # or: dnf install audit
systemctl enable --now auditd
/var/ossec/bin/wazuh-control restart
setup.verify: grep -i whodata /var/ossec/logs/ossec.log | tail  — expect no 'Who-data engine could not start' message.
setup.verify_zh: grep -i whodata /var/ossec/logs/ossec.log | tail —— 不應出現 who-data 引擎無法啟動的訊息。

setup.title: Regenerate the web-file baseline
setup.title_zh: 重新產生網站檔案基準清單
setup.body: etc/lists/zimbra-webfiles lists the files Zimbra itself ships. Regenerate it on the Zimbra server after every install and every upgrade, copy it to the manager and reload the ruleset; an upgrade renames version-stamped jars that the old list does not know.
setup.body_zh: etc/lists/zimbra-webfiles 列出 Zimbra 自帶的檔案。每次安裝與升級後都要在 Zimbra 伺服器上重新產生，複製到管理端並重新載入規則集；升級會改掉帶版本號的 jar 檔名，舊清單認不得。
setup.code: { find /opt/zimbra/jetty_base/webapps -type f \( -name '*.jsp' -o -name '*.jspx' -o -name '*.jar' -o -name '*.class' -o -name '*.war' -o -name '*.html' \); find /opt/zimbra/lib/ext -type f; } | sort -u | sed 's/$/:legit/' > zimbra-webfiles

setup.title: Optional: list addresses that are internal although public
setup.title_zh: 選用：列出雖是公開位址但屬於內部的位址
setup.body: Private ranges are built into the rules. If an office NAT address or a proxy (Z-Push, a reverse proxy) has a public address, add it to etc/lists/zimbra-internal-networks and reload the ruleset: its logins and failures are then never treated as external, and the active responses never block it.
setup.body_zh: 私有網段已內建在規則中。若辦公室 NAT 位址或代理（Z-Push、反向代理）使用公開位址，請把它加入 etc/lists/zimbra-internal-networks 並重新載入規則集：它的登入與失敗就不會被當成外部來源，主動回應也不會封鎖它。

setup.title: Optional: list accounts that read a lot with their own credentials
setup.title_zh: 選用：列出以自己帳號大量讀信的帳號
setup.body: Not needed by default. One account per line, the full address, then reload the ruleset. Bulk reading by these accounts (100972/100973) stops alerting. A tool working through a delegated administrator session from a private address needs no entry.
setup.body_zh: 預設不需要。每行一個帳號，寫完整位址，然後重新載入規則集。這些帳號的大量讀信（100972/100973）不再告警。從私有位址透過管理員委派工作階段運作的工具不需要列入。

setup.title: Do not collect /var/log/mail.log as well as /var/log/zimbra.log
setup.body: On a Zimbra server both files receive the same Postfix lines, so every Postfix event arrives twice and every Postfix frequency rule fires at half its threshold. If the agent's own ossec.conf lists /var/log/mail.log, remove that localfile and restart the agent. Nothing changes on the mail server itself.
setup.body_zh: 在 Zimbra 伺服器上兩個檔會收到相同的 Postfix 記錄，每個 Postfix 事件都會進來兩次，Postfix 的頻率類規則等於門檻減半。若 agent 自己的 ossec.conf 列了 /var/log/mail.log，請移除該 localfile 並重啟 agent。郵件伺服器本身不需任何變更。

setup.title: Check an older zimbra group configuration for patterns that match nothing
setup.title_zh: 檢查舊版 zimbra 群組設定中永遠比對不到的樣式
setup.body: syscheck's restrict and <ignore type="sregex"> are OS_Match: only ^ $ | ! are special. A pattern written as a regular expression, such as restrict="\.(jsp|sh)$" or ^/opt/zimbra/conf/(ca|nginx/includes), matches nothing: the restricted directories report no file at all and the ignore excludes nothing. The pack's agent.conf uses the OS_Match form (.jsp$|.sh$).
setup.body_zh: syscheck 的 restrict 與 <ignore type="sregex"> 都是 OS_Match：只有 ^ $ | ! 是特殊字元。寫成正規表示式的樣式，例如 restrict="\.(jsp|sh)$" 或 ^/opt/zimbra/conf/(ca|nginx/includes)，永遠比對不到：受限目錄完全不會回報任何檔案，ignore 也排除不了任何東西。套件的 agent.conf 使用 OS_Match 寫法（.jsp$|.sh$）。

active_response.title: Block an external address that keeps failing to log in to Zimbra
active_response.title_zh: 封鎖一再登入 Zimbra 失敗的外部位址
active_response.body: Drops traffic from the source address on the Zimbra server for 10 minutes after repeated login failures (100859) or password spraying (100836) from a public address; private ranges are built into the rules and addresses listed in zimbra-internal-networks are never included. The address is the client Zimbra recorded, which for a request through Z-Push or a reverse proxy is the address that proxy reported: a block on the mail server then has no effect, because the connection comes from the proxy, and blocking belongs on the proxy or the edge firewall instead. Risks: a mobile carrier or office NAT address is shared by many people, who are all locked out together; if a proxy appends to a client-supplied X-Forwarded-For header, an attacker can choose the address and make you block someone else, including an administrator; a proxy with a public address that is not listed in zimbra-internal-networks would be blocked itself and cut off every user behind it (for Z-Push, every phone). Put such addresses in zimbra-internal-networks and in the manager's white_list first. fail2ban on the same server blocks with the same iptables: if it already has a Zimbra jail, leave this off and let the jt-fail2ban pack report its bans.
active_response.body_zh: 公開位址一再登入失敗（100859）或密碼噴灑（100836）時，在 Zimbra 伺服器上封鎖該來源 10 分鐘；私有網段已內建在規則中，列在 zimbra-internal-networks 的位址永遠不會被包含。這個位址是 Zimbra 記下的用戶端；經 Z-Push 或反向代理進來的請求，是代理回報的位址：此時在郵件伺服器上封鎖沒有效果，因為連線來自代理，應改在代理或邊界防火牆封鎖。風險：電信業者或辦公室的 NAT 位址由許多人共用，會一起被擋；代理若把位址附加在用戶端自帶的 X-Forwarded-For 之後，攻擊者可以指定位址，讓你去封鎖別人，包括管理者；使用公開位址、卻沒列入 zimbra-internal-networks 的代理本身會被封鎖，切斷它後面的所有使用者（Z-Push 就是所有手機）。請先把這類位址放進 zimbra-internal-networks 和管理端的 white_list。同一台伺服器上的 fail2ban 用的是同一套 iptables：如果它已經有 Zimbra 的 jail，請不要啟用這項，交給 jt-fail2ban 套件回報封鎖。

active_response.title: Block an external address scanning Zimbra's web paths
active_response.title_zh: 封鎖掃描 Zimbra 網頁路徑的外部位址
active_response.body: Drops traffic from the source address on the Zimbra server for 10 minutes after 20 or more 404 responses in two minutes from a public address (private ranges and addresses listed in zimbra-internal-networks end at 100984/100985 instead, often a proxy carrying many clients). The address comes from Zimbra's own nginx log, so it is the connecting client; behind a reverse proxy with a public address, list that proxy. Risk: a shared NAT address, and a misbehaving client of a real user, are blocked for the 10 minutes.
active_response.body_zh: 公開位址在兩分鐘內出現 20 次以上 404 時，在 Zimbra 伺服器上封鎖該來源 10 分鐘（私有網段與列在 zimbra-internal-networks 的位址會停在 100984/100985，常是帶著許多用戶端的代理）。位址取自 Zimbra 自己的 nginx 記錄，也就是連線的用戶端；若前面有使用公開位址的反向代理，請把它列入清單。風險：共用的 NAT 位址，以及真實使用者行為異常的用戶端，會被封鎖 10 分鐘。
